Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a combination of cell cycle synchronization (mitosis vs interphase) and enzymatic perturbation (RNase treatment) to identify RNA-dependent proteins. The cell cycle state is mapped to 'un-classified' as it is a physiological state rather than a perturbation modality defined in the ontology. Thymidine and Nocodazole are used as synchronization agents (inhibitors).
